import json
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///:memory:'
app.json.sort_keys = False
db = SQLAlchemy(app)

class Book(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(200), nullable=False)
    author = db.Column(db.String(100), nullable=False)
    pages = db.Column(db.Integer, nullable=False)

@app.route('/add', methods=['POST'])
def add_book():
    data = request.get_json()
    book = Book(title=data['title'], author=data['author'], pages=data['pages'])
    db.session.add(book)
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'message': f'Added: {book.title}'}), 201

@app.route('/books')
def get_books():
    books = Book.query.all()
    return jsonify([{'id': b.id, 'title': b.title, 'author': b.author, 'pages': b.pages} for b in books])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    with app.app_context():
        db.create_all()
    client = app.test_client()
    resp = client.post('/add', json={'title': 'Python Mastery', 'author': 'Vaathiyaar', 'pages': 350})
    print('POST /add →', json.dumps(resp.get_json()))
    resp = client.get('/books')
    print('GET /books →', json.dumps(resp.get_json()))
